inputs.text: [curious] MOS… kops. "Moschos," in Greek, is a calf — [serious] a baby cow. And "ops," face.
[happily] Right — scientists thought his big head looked like a calf's. [amazed] He lived in South Africa, two hundred sixty-five million years ago.
[confident] Even before, yes. A very ancient cousin of furry animals — [warmly] like Gorgonops, who lived in the same region.
